The function only supports details: "roster", "results", "upcoming_matches". It doesn't support top scorer directly. We could retrieve roster and then manually determine top scorer? But we don't have stats. We might need to answer based on known knowledge: LeBron James is the all-time leading scorer for Lakers. Or current season top scorer: LeBron James or maybe Anthony Davis. But the question likely expects LeBron James. So answer: LeBron James.
